page: Microsoft Azure E96pds_v7 is an ARM-based, memory-optimized virtual machine delivered via Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 96 dedicated vCPUs built on 64-bit ARM architecture (arm64) and integrates 768.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per core ratio. Acceleration hardware such as dedicated GPUs is not present on this instance type.

Storage configuration includes 5670 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD capacity, providing fast physical disk access directly attached to the host alongside Premium Storage remote disk support. In terms of networking constraints, complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provided by default. The ARM instruction set eliminates legacy x86 features such as AVX, AVX-512, and AMX extensions, requiring target software stacks to be compiled natively for arm64 environments.

Due to its substantial memory pool and 1:8 core-to-memory distribution, this server offers efficient resource density for workloads requiring significant RAM footprints without over-allocating compute. The combined local NVMe disk array and high vCPU count make Microsoft Azure E96pds_v7 suitable for large relational database systems, in-memory caching solutions, enterprise resource planning installations, and substantial data analytics processing pipelines.

The dense ratio of memory paired with high local NVMe throughput establishes Microsoft Azure E96pds_v7 as an effective option for in-memory databases, large-scale caching clusters, data analytics engines, and transactional database servers requiring significant memory allocations.
